dashboards.description: Unified operational, statistical, and predictive visibility into Fusion ESS jobs, combining windowed execution signals with long-term behavioral risk indicators.

savedSearches.description: Identifies jobs where alerting and predictions are unreliable due to insufficient run history or unstable metrics

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | eval confidenceLevel = if(succeededRuns < 3, LOW, if(confidenceScoreWeighted >= 0.75, HIGH, if(confidenceScoreWeighted >= 0.40, MEDIUM, LOW))) | where confidenceLevel = LOW | fields job, succeededRuns, runtimeVolatilityIndex, runtimeTrendSlopePerRun | stats count as logrecords by job

savedSearches.description:
Classifies jobs as NORMAL / RUNTIME_REGRESSION based on:
lastRuntime > previousRuntime × regressionFactor
Why it matters
•	Detects performance decay
•	CIS: baseline deviation monitoring

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | eval regressionDriver = if(succeededRuns < 3, "Insufficient History", if(runtimeVolatilityIndex > 1, "High Runtime Variance", if(runtimeTrendSlopePerRun > 0, "Upward Runtime Trend", if(lastRuntimeMinutes > previousRuntimeMinutes, "Recent Runtime Spike", Stable)))) | stats count as jobCount by status, regressionDriver | sort status, -jobCount

savedSearches.description:
Counts jobs by computed confidenceLevel (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), derived from:
•	Run volume
•	Runtime volatility
•	Trend availability

Why it matters
•	Shows model reliability
•	CIS: quality of monitoring controls
•	Prevents false confidence in weak signals

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | eval confidenceLevel = if(succeededRuns < 3, LOW, if(confidenceScoreWeighted >= 0.75, HIGH, if(confidenceScoreWeighted >= 0.40, MEDIUM, LOW))) | fields job, confidenceLevel, succeededRuns, runtimeVolatilityIndex, runtimeTrendSlopePerRun, jobRiskScore | stats count as jobCount, avg(succeededRuns) as avgRuns, avg(runtimeVolatilityIndex) as avgVolatility, avg(jobRiskScore) as avgRisk by confidenceLevel | eval confidenceOrder = if(confidenceLevel = HIGH, 1, if(confidenceLevel = MEDIUM, 2, 3)) | sort confidenceOrder | fields -confidenceOrder

savedSearches.description: This chart shows where our ESS job risk is concentrated, and whether that risk is driven by instability or SLA exposure, allowing us to focus remediation where it matters most.

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | eval riskBucket = if(jobRiskScore >= 0.75, High, if(jobRiskScore >= 0.6, Medium, if(jobRiskScore >= 0.4, Low, "Very Low"))) | stats count as jobCount, avg(slaBreachProbability) as avgSlaRisk, avg(runtimeVolatilityIndex) as avgVolatility by riskBucket

savedSearches.description:
Classifies jobs as NORMAL / RUNTIME_REGRESSION based on:
lastRuntime > previousRuntime × regressionFactor
Why it matters
•	Detects performance decay
•	CIS: baseline deviation monitoring

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | fields job, status, succeededRuns, lastRuntimeMinutes, previousRuntimeMinutes, runtimeVolatilityIndex, runtimeTrendSlopePerRun, jobRiskScore | stats count as jobCount, avg(succeededRuns) as avgSucceededRuns, avg(lastRuntimeMinutes) as avgLastRuntime, avg(previousRuntimeMinutes) as avgPreviousRuntime, avg(runtimeVolatilityIndex) as avgVolatility, avg(runtimeTrendSlopePerRun) as avgTrendSlope, avg(jobRiskScore) as avgRiskScore by status | sort -jobCount

savedSearches.description: How reliably and predictably are my ESS jobs executing ?

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats sum(succeededRuns) as Success, sum(warningRuns) as warning, sum(totalRuns) as total | where total > 0 | eval ESS_Accuracy_Rate = round(((Success + warning) * 100) / total, 2) | stats max(ESS_Accuracy_Rate) as ESS_Accuracy_Rate

savedSearches.description:
•	Identifies:
o	Noisy service accounts
o	Rogue integrations
o	Overactive modules
•	CIS relevance: accountability & traceability of automated jobs

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats count as runs by sbmtr | sort -runs

savedSearches.description: Jobs showing high predicted risk or SLA breach probability despite zero recent failures

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | where failuresLast24Hours = 0 | where jobRiskScore >= 0.3 or slaBreachProbability >= 0.1 | stats max(jobRiskScore) as jobRiskScore, max(slaBreachProbability) as slaBreachProbability by job | sort -jobRiskScore, -slaBreachProbability

savedSearches.description: How Many Jobs Processed in Given Time Window ?

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats sum(totalRuns) as TotalJobRuns

savedSearches.description:
Shows jobs with:
•	20k+ runs
•	MEDIUM confidence
•	Low visible failures
These are latent risks,	Small defect × massive volume = systemic outage

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | where totalRuns > 20 | stats sum(totalRuns) as totalRuns by job | sort -totalRuns

savedSearches.description:
Lists all jobs currently in alert state.
Why it matters
•	SOC / Ops action list
•	CIS: incident detection

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats latest(Time) as Time, latest(ID) as ID, latest('Alarm Status') as alarmstatus, latest(Severity) as sevlvl, latest(Cause) as cause, latest(Job) as job, latest('Deployed Application') as depapp, latest(Product) as product, latest('Request Type') as reqtype, latest(succeededRuns) as succeededRuns, latest(confidenceScoreWeighted) as confidenceScoreWeighted, latest(jobRiskScore) as jobRiskScore, latest(predictedFailureProbability) as predictedFailureProbability, latest(slaBreachProbability) as slaBreachProbability, latest(stuckJobProbability) as stuckJobProbability, latest(Status) as status, latest(failuresLast24Hours) as failuresLast24Hours, latest(failuresLast7Days) as failuresLast7Days, latest(FusionLastRunEndTime) as FusionLastRunEndTime, latest(FusionlastRunTimestamp) as FusionlastRunTimestamp, latest(runningRuns) as runningRuns, latest(maxRunningDurationHours) as maxRunningDurationHours, latest('Request ID') as reqid, latest('Last ID') as lastid, latest('Job ID') as jobid, latest('Schedule Type') as schedtype by 'Job Definition ID' | eval confidenceLevel = if(succeededRuns < 3, LOW, if(confidenceScoreWeighted >= 0.75, HIGH, if(confidenceScoreWeighted >= 0.4, MEDIUM, LOW))) | where alarmstatus = Y | fields Time, ID, alarmstatus, sevlvl, cause, job, 'Job Definition ID', depapp, product, reqtype, confidenceLevel, jobRiskScore, predictedFailureProbability, slaBreachProbability, stuckJobProbability, status, failuresLast24Hours, failuresLast7Days, FusionLastRunEndTime, FusionlastRunTimestamp, runningRuns, maxRunningDurationHours, reqid, lastid, jobid, schedtype | fields -succeededRuns, -confidenceScoreWeighted | sort -Time

savedSearches.description: How Often Jobs Break

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats sum(failedRuns) as Failed, sum(totalRuns) as total | where total > 0 | eval ESS_Failure_Rate = round((Failed * 100) / total, 2) | stats max(ESS_Failure_Rate) as ESS_Failure_Rate

savedSearches.description:
Shows Top ten Jobs with composite risk based on failure, SLA, volatility, and trend, Counts jobs with composite jobRiskScore, derived from:
•	Failure probability
•	SLA risk
•	Runtime volatility
•	Trend slope
•	Stuck probability

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats max(jobRiskScore) as jobRiskScore, max(slaBreachProbability) as slaRisk, max(predictedFailureProbability) as predictedFailureRisk, max(runtimeVolatilityIndex) as volatility by job, jobdefid | sort -jobRiskScore | top limit=10 jobRiskScore

savedSearches.description:
Shows average runtime evolution over time.
Why it matters
•	Capacity & performance planning
•	Early degradation visibility

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats avg(lastRuntimeMinutes) as actual, avg(p95RuntimeBaselineMinutes) as baseline by job | eval deviation = actual - baseline | sort -deviation

savedSearches.description:
Displays the number of ESS jobs that experienced at least one failure in each time window.
Counts job health records where failures were reported and aggregates them per time bucket.
Each data point represents the breadth of impact (how many jobs failed), not the total number of failures.

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | where failedRuns > 0 | timestats sum(failedRuns) as failureEvents

savedSearches.description:
Why it matters
•	Detects uncontrolled ad-hoc usage
•	Supports governance & change management

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats sum(scheduledCount) as SCHEDULED, sum(adhocCount) as ADHOC

savedSearches.description:
Identifies jobs with unstable runtimes using:
runtimeVolatilityIndex = stddev / mean
Why it matters
•	Predicts failure likelihood
•	CIS: anomaly detection

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats avg(runtimeVolatilityIndex) as volatility by job | top limit=10 volatility

savedSearches.description: Which jobs are Failing Most - Calculated by Failed Runs/Total Runs

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats sum(failedRuns) as failedRuns, sum(totalRuns) as totalRuns by job | where totalRuns > 0 | eval errorRate = (failedRuns * 100) / totalRuns | where errorRate > 0 | sort -errorRate | head limit=20

savedSearches.description:
Shows average runtime snapshot Per Job
Why it matters
•	Capacity & performance planning
•	Early degradation visibility

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | timestats avg(lastRuntimeMinutes) as avgRuntime

savedSearches.description: Aggregates jobs by Fusion application/module

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats count by depapp | sort -Count

savedSearches.description:
Which jobs are active, and when?
Shows when each ESS job had activity signals over time.
Each cell indicates the presence of job execution activity in that time bucket, not the exact run count.

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | timestats sum(totalRuns) as executions by job

savedSearches.description:
•	Shows ESS cluster pressure
•	Helps infra teams correlate:
o	CPU spikes
o	JVM GC
o	SOA congestion

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats count by procgrp

savedSearches.description:
Why

Shows why alerts are firing
Helps justify predictive model to stakeholders

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | where cause != null | eval AlertReason = cause | stats count as alertCount by AlertReason | sort -alertCount

savedSearches.description:
Aggregates execution results across all jobs.
Why it matters
•	Reliability posture
•	CIS: failure monitoring

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats sum(succeededRuns) as success, sum(failedRuns) as failed, sum(cancelledRuns) as cancelled, sum(warningRuns) as warning, sum(runningRuns) as running, sum(blockedRuns) as blocked, sum(queuePressure) as queue

savedSearches.description:
Counts jobs where slaBreachProbability ≥ 0.2
Derived statistically from runtime exceeding historical P95 baseline.

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | where slaBreachProbability > 0 | stats max(slaBreachProbability) as slaBreachProbability, max(avgRuntimeMinutes) as avgRuntimeMinutes, max(p95RuntimeBaselineMinutes) as p95Baseline by job, jobdefid | sort -slaBreachProbability

savedSearches.description:
Identifies jobs with highest runtime.
Why it matters
•	Bottleneck analysis
•	Capacity planning

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats max(lastRuntimeMinutes) as runtime by job | sort -runtime | top limit=10 runtime

savedSearches.description: Highlights ESS jobs with consistently high success rates

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats sum(succeededRuns) as succeededRuns, sum(totalRuns) as totalRuns by job | where totalRuns > 0 | eval successPct = (succeededRuns * 100) / totalRuns | where successPct >= 99 | sort -successPct | head limit=10

savedSearches.description: Shows Jobs which are Scheduled very Frequently

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | where schedtype = Y | stats sum(totalRuns) as totalRuns by job | sort -totalRuns

savedSearches.description: Top ten Jobs which are Likely to Fail with predictedFailureProbability >= 0.1

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | where predictedFailureProbability >= 0.1 | stats max(predictedFailureProbability) as predictedFailureProbability by job | sort -predictedFailureProbability | top limit=10 predictedFailureProbability

savedSearches.description:
Which jobs run the most (volume)?
Ranks ESS jobs by total execution volume within the selected time range.

uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = Fusion_ESSHealthRPT_SOAP | stats sum(totalRuns) as runs by job | sort -runs | head limit=10
